item.title: Re: seeking greenlights: a forest clearing
item.content:encoded:
Let's see what we have here.

[+] Here, have some crit
[-] OK, now give me back my crit

The pocket dimension is something like a paradise version of the original forest clearing

I think you should explain a little more on this. What do you mean by 'paradise'? What's different from the real forest? You can play with the descriptions and/or physics of the pocket dimension. I think you should try to make the reader into 'feel' the sensation of what is like to be there.

in the middle of the forest clearing is an old ruin

Who lived there? Why no one lives there anymore? You can play with this. What was life like in there? You can have a lot of worldbuilding here. Maybe you can use it to show how a civilization living in "paradise" rose and fell? Maybe you can make this a metaphor of utopias and their inevitable collapse?

the portal got unstable and is now neutralized

This part could also be a metaphor about "dream places" being destined to collapse. This would be a nice and simple ending to a good story.

the will to stay in the pd grows with the time

Maybe, along with the pd, the traces of the civilization also grow? This way your story will have some type of escalation through the article. Maybe you could write one exploration log about a D-Class going in there and being happy while discovering the place's history?

if anyone tries to force someone to exit the pd after they spent more than 13 min in it, they'll do everything just to stay there

So how did the person who got lost even get out? I think they would've never leave, just because they would've not feel the necessity to do so. I think you should either get rid of this property, or came up with another story regarding its discovery. Maybe some disappearances? Maybe a group of friends find it and one of them got inside and didn't want to exit?

Overall, you have the opportunity to do a lot of worldbuilding here, and I think that would improve your article.

Feel free to contact a member of the Butterfly Squad to get more crit, or PM me to take another look.

item.title: seeking greenlights: a forest clearing
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Elevator Pitch:

  • A forest clearing in the swiss alps that works as a portal to a parallel-pocket-dimension if it's foggy
  • The pocket dimension is something like a paradise version of the original forest clearing

Central Narrative:

  • was discovered because a person got lost in the forest, accidently traveled in and out of the dimension and told in the village 3km nearby their experience
  • even thought there is no live in the dimension, in the middle of the forest clearing is an old ruin (only in the pd) indicating people living there centuries ago
  • the portal got unstable and is now neutralized

Hook/Attention-Grabber:

  • It's not possible to feel negative emotions in the pd, so they forget life-essential actions like drinking, eating or sleeping. They don't notice injuries either.
  • the will to stay in the pd grows with the time
  • if anyone tries to force someone to exit the pd after they spent more than 13 min in it, they'll do everything just to stay there (it's the only exception of negative feelings).

Additional Notes:

  • My first try to write an SCP!
  • English is not my native language
  • I didn't knew I have to get a greenlight first to post it on drafts critique, so I already wrote a draft.
  • Let me know if this idea is already used in a better way somewherer else
  • thanks for criticizing my idea!

edit: forgot to write about the neutralization stuff
